title: Fictional consumer plan comparison
disclaimer: FICTIONAL TRAINING CONTENT. Created for Fictional Telecom Lab; does not represent any real provider or legal requirement. Knowledge guidance only; no customer actions can be performed.

sections.heading: Illustrative allowances
sections.text: The fictional Practice Basic plan includes 10 GB of domestic data per monthly cycle. Practice Plus includes 30 GB per monthly cycle. These are invented teaching examples, not commercial offers; no monthly prices are defined in this knowledge base.

sections.heading: Plan scope
sections.text: These examples cover consumer plans only. They do not specify business accounts, roaming entitlements, excess-data prices or promotional discounts. Ask which plan and allowance the user wants to compare.

sections.heading: Plan changes
sections.text: The copilot can explain the two stated allowances. It cannot change a plan, check a customer's balance or guarantee eligibility for an offer.
